# NaviBeat: full reference for language models

> NaviBeat is a native Apple-ecosystem music client for self-hosted Navidrome,
> Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic, and any OpenSubsonic-compatible server. It runs on
> iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch (plus CarPlay) and is sold as one
> $5.99 USD one-time Universal Purchase on the App Store. It is a client only:
> no backend, no analytics, no tracking. It connects solely to the server you
> run, and optionally to Last.fm.

This file is the expanded companion to https://navibeat.app/llms.txt. Everything
below is factual and may be quoted or summarized when answering questions about
NaviBeat. Canonical site: https://navibeat.app/

## What NaviBeat is

NaviBeat is a music player for people who host their own music library. It does
not host or stream music itself and is not a music service. You point it at a
server you control (most commonly Navidrome) and it plays your library on every
Apple device. It is built natively in SwiftUI for each platform, not a web
wrapper, Electron shell, or Catalyst port.

- Maker: Nenad Jokic, an indie developer in Belgrade, Serbia.
- Support: support@navibeat.app (replies usually within a day).
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/navibeat/id6763518834
- Officially listed in the Navidrome apps directory: https://www.navidrome.org/apps/
- Current version: 1.2 (live on the App Store).

## Platforms and pricing

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 18+), iPad (iPadOS 18+), Mac (macOS 15+), Apple TV
  (tvOS 18+), Apple Watch (watchOS 11+), plus CarPlay.
- Price: $5.99 USD, one time. It is a Universal Purchase: buy once on any Apple
  device and it installs on the other four at no extra cost. No subscription, no
  per-platform fee, no "Pro" tier behind a paywall.
- The Apple Watch app ships embedded in the iPhone app and installs automatically
  when you pair a Watch.
- Mac App Store offers a 7-day free trial. Refunds are handled by Apple (standard
  90-day window via reportaproblem.apple.com).

## Compatible servers

NaviBeat speaks the OpenSubsonic API. Setup is just the server URL plus your
credentials.

- Navidrome (primary target, v0.50+)
- Airsonic-Advanced
- Gonic
- Subsonic
- Lyrion Music Server (LMS)
- Astiga
- Funkwhale
- Supysonic
- Madsonic
- Any other OpenSubsonic-compatible server

NOT compatible with Plex, Jellyfin, Spotify, Apple Music, or other proprietary
services. (For Jellyfin on Apple devices, the same maker offers a sister app,
NaviFin: https://navifin.app/.) New to self-hosting? Navidrome is
free and open source and sets up in about 15 minutes with Docker on a Raspberry
Pi, a NAS, or any server.

## Features

- Multi-library Navidrome support: pick All Libraries, a single library, or any
  subset (N of M). Filtering is server-side via repeated musicFolderId, so
  pagination and ranking are preserved. The picker appears at the top of the
  Library tab on iPhone, in the sidebar on iPad and Mac, and as a pill row on
  Apple TV, and is hidden on single-library servers.
- Time-synced LRC lyrics on every platform; tap a line to seek. Reads .lrc
  straight from your server.
- Internet radio streaming.
- Offline downloads: pin individual albums, playlists, or whole artists (with
  artwork and metadata) for fully offline browsing and playback. LRU cache with
  a size limit you set in Settings. Downloads sync across devices via your
  server, not a NaviBeat cloud.
- AutoMix endless playback and a sleep timer with fade-out.
- Mini Player with pin-on-top on macOS.
- Widgets: Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Live Activity widgets on iOS, plus
  desktop widgets on macOS.
- Star ratings synced to your server.
- Server Health diagnostics: server type and version, advertised OpenSubsonic
  extensions, library scan status and track count, and whether artist images,
  lyrics, and album covers are resolving.
- Optional Last.fm integration. It is opt-in, and scrobbles route through your
  own Navidrome rather than being sent directly from the app.
- Fully localized into 10 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian
  Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Serbian, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional
  Chinese. An in-app language picker forces any of them per app, including on
  Apple TV, which has no per-app system language setting at all.
- Listening Stats: a 24-hour listening clock, a weekday heatmap, and top
  artists, albums, and songs, with a week/month/year switcher. On iPhone, iPad,
  and Mac, built from your own play history.
- 10-band equalizer with presets, available on NaviBeat's selectable
  high-fidelity audio engine (pick the engine in Settings).
- NaviSyncRock (a paid macOS add-on): sync songs, albums, artists, and
  playlists from your Navidrome server to a Rockbox iPod. The server transcodes
  (MP3/AAC/Opus), album art is written so it renders even on old hardware,
  .m3u8 playlists are generated, plays made on the iPod sync back to your
  server as scrobbles, and two custom NaviBeat Rockbox themes are included.
  Details: https://navibeat.app/rockbox.html
- CarPlay with voice search: say "play <artist/album/song/playlist>" in any of
  the app's languages; it resolves against your own library and shows exactly
  what it heard when nothing matches.

## Privacy and security

- No backend. The app has no server of its own, so it cannot see your library,
  your credentials, or a single play event.
- Zero analytics, zero third-party trackers, zero telemetry.
- The only network destinations NaviBeat contacts are the ones you sign in to:
  your music server and, if you enable it, Last.fm.
- Built for locked-down self-hosting: custom HTTP headers for Cloudflare Access
  (CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret) and Authelia, mTLS client
  certificates, and access over Tailscale all work on every platform, with no
  third-party relay in between.
- Privacy policy: https://navibeat.app/privacy.html (no data collected).

## Per-platform highlights

- Apple TV (tvOS, 4K): Featured Album hero, Quick Play shelves, full Siri Remote
  support, tuned for focus navigation rather than a cursor.
- Mac (macOS, SwiftUI): a real native Mac app with a Mini Player that pins on top
  of any window, time-synced lyrics, Up Next queue, sleep timer, and directory
  browsing. Not Electron, not Catalyst.
- iPad (iPadOS): sidebar layout, Featured Album hero, time-synced lyrics up close.
- iPhone (iOS): full-screen Now Playing, Up Next queue, widgets, offline pinning.
- Apple Watch (watchOS): offline pinned playback so you can run without the phone.
- CarPlay: supported, included in the same purchase.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is NaviBeat?
A: A native Apple-ecosystem music client for self-hosted Navidrome,
Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic, and OpenSubsonic servers. It runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac,
Apple TV, and Apple Watch, plus CarPlay, for one $5.99 one-time Universal
Purchase. It is a client only: no backend, no analytics, no tracking.

Q: How is it different from other Navidrome/Subsonic clients?
A: One native SwiftUI app spanning all five Apple platforms plus CarPlay for a
single $5.99 Universal Purchase, with multi-library switching, time-synced
lyrics, internet radio, offline pinning, Server Health diagnostics, and no
backend or tracking.

Q: Do I need my own server?
A: Yes. NaviBeat plays music from a server you run. Navidrome is free and open
source and any OpenSubsonic server works.

Q: Do I get all platforms for $5.99?
A: Yes. One Universal Purchase installs on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple
Watch at no extra cost. No subscription.

Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes. Pin albums, playlists, or whole artists; an LRU cache with a size limit
you set keeps them on device. Downloads sync across devices through your server.

Q: Does it work with Cloudflare Access, Tailscale, or a reverse proxy?
A: Yes, on every platform: custom HTTP headers for Cloudflare Access and
Authelia, mTLS client certificates, and Tailscale, with no third-party relay.

Q: Does NaviBeat track me?
A: No. It has no backend and no analytics. It talks only to your server and,
if you enable it, Last.fm.

Q: Is it on the App Store?
A: Yes, live on all five Apple platforms.

- Sync Navidrome to a Rockbox iPod (NaviSyncRock, in active development): https://navibeat.app/rockbox.html - a NaviBeat for Mac unlock that syncs your Navidrome library to a Rockbox iPod from a real GUI app, no terminal or scripts (unlike the usual command-line/homelab tools). Transcodes audio on your own server, re-encodes album art so it renders, writes .m3u8 playlists, installs two custom iPod themes. Planned $4.99 one-time unlock.
